<style class="gs-focus-css">
/* Funnel focus mode (user round): once the visitor moves past screen 1 into the order
   flow, everything after the funnel is a distraction wall. The script below hides every
   element that follows #orderFunnel in document order (all ancestor levels up to body,
   footer included) while any screen other than "menu" is active, and restores it on the
   way back. Read-only with respect to the form: it observes class flips the funnel makes
   itself and never touches nodes inside the order form. If the script fails the page
   simply keeps its current behaviour. */
.gs-focus-hidden{display:none!important}
</style>
<script>
(function(){
  var root=document.getElementById('orderFunnel');
  if(!root)return;
  var after=[];
  var node=root;
  while(node&&node.parentElement&&node!==document.body){
    var sib=node.nextElementSibling;
    while(sib){after.push(sib);sib=sib.nextElementSibling;}
    node=node.parentElement;
  }
  if(!after.length)return;
  function apply(){
    var s=root.querySelector('.of-screen.is-active');
    var focus=!!s&&s.getAttribute('data-screen')!=='menu';
    for(var i=0;i<after.length;i++){after[i].classList.toggle('gs-focus-hidden',focus);}
  }
  apply();
  if('MutationObserver' in window){
    new MutationObserver(apply).observe(root,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class'],subtree:true});
  }
})();
</script>
